title: Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight
altTitles: Return of the Calamity-Class Death Knight
Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight
The Death Knight of Apocalypse Returns
滅亡級デスナイトが回帰する
description: Damian Haksen was a gifted warrior destined for greatness, but the powerful Archlich Dorgo transformed him into a Death Knight and enslaved him with dark magic. Under the Archlich's command, Damian slaughtered his own family and brought ruin to kingdoms. At the very end, he regained his consciousness, but it was too late to undo the destruction he had caused. Just as he was ready to give up everything, a miracle occurred: he regressed to the time before it all began. Determined to protect his family this time, Damian sets out to destroy the dark mage who ruined his life and rewrite his tragic fate.
author: Orange Mango
